title: Career roadmap · Buyer
summary: A Buyer identifies products that fit a target customer and brand, evaluates suppliers, negotiates commercial terms, plans assortments, and uses sales and market data to make purchasing decisions.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 4-year undergraduate pathway beginning in 2026. If the BBA is 3 years, complete the equivalent milestones by the final year and use the additional time for internships, retail exposure, and buying/merchandising portfolio work.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build fashion/luxury business fundamentals, product knowledge, consumer behaviour, retail analytics, merchandising and supplier-management skills.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Specialise in fashion buying, luxury buying, category buying, merchandise planning or retail buying.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress toward Senior Buyer, Category Manager, Buying Manager or Merchandise Manager.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine buying expertise with AI demand forecasting, customer analytics, sustainability, omnichannel retail and global sourcing.

2040–2046 relevance

Buying will increasingly combine commercial judgement with AI demand forecasting, predictive inventory planning, customer analytics, digital product discovery, personalization, sustainability data, traceable sourcing and omnichannel retail. Senior buyers should become commercial decision-makers who can balance brand identity, customer demand, margins, inventory risk and responsible sourcing.
